facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A light flashed. The frog changed. He was a prince. He became a prince.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: One evening, the princess said something kind from her heart. Suddenly, a bright light surrounded the little frog. His body started changing right before her eyes. He became a prince, tall and handsome. The princess could not believe what was happening. The magic spell was finally broken by her true kindness.
facts.Word cards: became = 됐다 / prince = 왕자 / miracle = 기적 / frog = 개구리
